title: Exact shifts for the pinned projection followed by a map to the tensor unit
statement:
Let $f:Z	o Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-scheme]. Fix derived categories of their module sheaves in one localization universe, and derived categories of modules on every open of $Y$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Use the recorded derived pullback $L=Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct image $R_0=Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and K-flat derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Assume the full subcategories $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ and $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Z)$ are triangulated for their induced shifts and ambient distinguished triangles. Assume $R_0$ carries quasi-coherent objects to quasi-coherent objects, and $\mathcal O_Y$ is quasi-coherent. Fix $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Z)$, and assume $LK\otimes E$ is quasi-coherent for every $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$. Give $L$ a specified monoidal structure and fix $a:L\dashv R_0$. Put $Q(K)=LK\otimes E$ as a quasi-coherent functor, and let $R$ be the quasi-coherent restriction of $R_0$. Fix $\epsilon:RE	o\mathcal O_Y$ and a natural transformation $
u:Q\circ R\Rightarrow\mathrm{id}$, where $Q\circ R$ denotes applying $Q$ first and then $R$. For every $K$, suppose there is an isomorphism $p_K:R_0(LK\otimes E)\cong K\otimes R_0E$ satisfying $p_K^{-1}=a.\operatorname{homEquiv}(\mu_L(K,R_0E)^{-1}\mathbin{;} (LK\otimes\epsilon^a_E))$ and whose composite with $K\otimes\epsilon$ and the right unitor equals the ambient map of $
u_K$. Here semicolon denotes composition in the order written. Then there are coherent integer shift structures on $Q$ and $R$ for which both functors preserve distinguished triangles and $
u$ commutes with every integer shift. This statement makes no assertion about a right adjoint of $R$, and involves no comparison map to such a right adjoint.

proof.text: On K-flat representatives, pullback followed by tensoring E commutes coherently with translation and takes mapping cones to mapping cones. Direct image computed on K-injectives also commutes with translation and mapping cones. The assumed triangulated quasi-coherent properties allow restriction to Q and R. For the specified monoidal structure, transport the pullback translation comparison using K[n] = K tensor the shifted unit and the tensorator. The associativity and unit equations give addition and zero coherence. Transport the direct-image comparison through the adjunction a. The representative mapping-cone identifications give preservation of distinguished triangles for these structures.

Expand the pinned inverse projection as the adjunction mate of the inverse tensorator followed by the pullback counit. Move translation through those factors with the transported comparisons of step 1. Counit naturality and the adjunction triangle identities identify the component on K[n] with the translated component on K. Invert this equality using p_K. Tensoring the fixed morphism epsilon is natural in the translated first variable, and the right unitor has the same comparison. Composing these compatibility equations gives the shift equation for nu via its specified component equation. No component of nu or epsilon is cancelled; the argument includes zero E, zero epsilon, and zero triangles.

theorem pinnedProjectionCounit_exactShift
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [(schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).IsTriangulated]
    [(schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).IsTriangulated]
    (hRf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj))
    (hO : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y)))
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z)
    (hTensor : ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ E.obj))
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (ε : (⟨(schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj, hRf E⟩ :
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) ⟶ ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩)
    (ν : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⋙ derivedPullback f ⋙ tensorRight E.obj)
      hTensor ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) hRf ⟶
      𝟭 (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y))
    (hν : ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y,
      ∃ pf : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
            (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ E.obj) ≅
          K.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj,
        pf.inv = (a.homEquiv _ _)
          ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (derivedPullback f) K.obj
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj)).inv ≫
            (derivedPullback f).obj K.obj ◁ a.counit.app E.obj) ∧
        (ν.app K).hom = pf.hom ≫ K.obj ◁ ε.hom ≫ (ρ_ K.obj).hom) :
    let Q := (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⋙ derivedPullback f ⋙ tensorRight E.obj) hTensor
    let R := (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) hRf
    ∃ (sQ : Q.CommShift ℤ) (sR : R.CommShift ℤ),
      letI := sQ
      letI := sR
      Q.IsTriangulated ∧ R.IsTriangulated ∧ NatTrans.CommShift ν ℤ
